candidate_relations.reason: The lymph node histology supports KFD, with hemophagocytosis and aseptic meningitis as complications. HLH with nonspecific CNS involvement is not the full referenced diagnostic composite.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures hemophagocytic activity and neurologic involvement but omits the underlying Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease and does not specifically identify aseptic meningitis.
